This inviting home features a modern, comfortable layout and quality finishes throughout. The living and dining areas feel bright and open, with well-proportioned rooms that create a natural flow and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Hardwood floors. Residents enjoy a peaceful residential setting while still incredibly close to everything. One car garage. Attic for storage.

Perfectly perched on a quiet cul-de-sac in Tarrytown, offering the best of both worlds: a wonderful Tarrytown location and the highly regarded Irvington school district. Enjoy all that Tarrytown has to offer, from its vibrant restaurants and shops to its Hudson River setting and convenient access to transportation. The nearby Tarrytown Metro-North station offers an easy commute to Grand Central. A wonderful home, neighborhood, and lifestyle all in one exceptional location.
